title: Three Tips for a Better Memory
subtitle: 短文

transcript.t: Do you often forget things? Here are three tips.
First, organize what you learn. Divide a long list into small groups, and it will be easier to remember.
Second, make a picture in your mind. If you want to remember the word dolphin, imagine a dolphin jumping out of the water.
Third, review often. Our brain forgets quickly, so look at your notes the next day, and again a week later. Do not wait until the night before the exam.
With these techniques, your memory will become stronger.
